thread:
pagerduty-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty: Incident triggered by policy 'canary-5xx-rate' — 5xx spike on inference service in us-west-2-canary. Alert ID: PD-89431. Autopage chain started.

oncall-rotation: acked — I'm oncall, looking. Can anyone from eng-runtime confirm a recent deploy to canary?

esther: yep, I merged the RLHF quantization kernel change earlier (deploy ID d-2026-03-14-57). Canary rollout started ~5 min ago. Seeing a small bump in errors in smoke tests but thought it was noise.

josh: I see the PD alert, looks like p50 latency fine but p99 and 5xxs up ~12% in canary. Logs show OOM traces coming from quant kernel path.

mike: tagging @sara who did the packaging. Sara — did the quant build differ for canary vs stable?

sara: the canary image uses q8-int packing + new fused matmul kernel. Stable still on q4f16. We expected perf improvements. No tests for long-context KV cache combos though.

oncall-rotation: can we confirm customer impact? telemetry-team, any drop in overall success rate or error budgets?

pm-arya: CS reporting a couple enterprise customers saw errors in their QA environments. Overall platform error rate across region ~1.7% but for canary traffic slice ~11%. No billing impact yet.

josh: stack snippet from failing worker:```
E tensorflow/core/common_runtime/executor.cc: Allocation failed: out of memory
...
InferenceServer: failed to allocate quant buffer (size=1.2GB)
```

esther: that's consistent with a regression in kernel memory accounting when seq_len > 2048 + kv cache warmup. Canary config uses long-context warmup.

oncall-rotation: plan: 1) divert canary traffic back to stable 2) pause rollout 3) rollback canary image 4) root cause postmortem. Who can flip traffic?

mike: I'll run traffic-split rollback via rollout-manager. Command: `rollout-manager rollback --target canary --to stable-2026-03-13-22`

deploy-bot: Deploy command accepted, initiating traffic shift. Progress: 30% -> 60% -> 100% stable.

pm-arya: quick note for CS: telling affected customers we detected a canary regression and are rolling back, ETA ~5-10m.

esther: while rollback proceeds I'll attach a short patch to disable fused matmul and add an assert on kv allocation to catch this earlier.

sara: can you also push a hotfix image to staging with reduced batch size to reduce memory pressure? I can build after rollback confirmed.

josh: ack, I'm tailing logs. After traffic shift we should see canary 5xx drop.

oncall-rotation: PD escalation: autopage also notified oncall-sre-2; both pages acknowledged. No escalation required if rollback completes.

deploy-bot: Traffic diversion completed, 100% to stable-2026-03-13-22.

josh: confirming 5xxs down to baseline across region in the last 60s. p99 latencies returning to norm.

esther: rollback accepted, marking the quant kernel PR as reverted. I'll open a follow-up branch to add long-context kv unit tests.

mike: I'm creating a hotfix follow-up ticket and linking telemetry graphs + the specific failing trace IDs.

pm-arya: CS updated customers: "We rolled back the canary release causing inference errors for some QA workloads. No production data was lost; we're investigating and will share a timeline for the fix."

oncall-rotation: thanks everyone. I'm going to close this PD incident once we confirm stability for 30m. Postmortem owners: esther + sara.

sara: noted. I'll prepare a short RCA draft: root cause = memory accounting change in fused kernel with long-context kv cache; mitigations = rollback, add unit tests, limit canary long-context by default.

josh: adding one more thing — add an alert for canary memory footprint delta > 20% in the future to catch this earlier.

oncall-rotation: tagging the follow ups: #postmortems, #eng-runtime. Closing timeline: first alert at 3724200000, rollback completed by 3724200120, incident quiet by 3724200240.

pagerduty-bot: Incident PD-89431 status: acknowledged -> resolved. Incident notes added by oncall-rotation.

pm-arya: summary for ops: Impact = canary slice only, ~11% 5xx during rollout window, a few customer QA failures, no broad prod impact. Actions: revert PR, add tests, add canary mem delta alert, update rollout gating checklist.

oncall-rotation: closing thread. Thanks all :thumbsup:
